# BrowserProof
> Proof, not vibes, for browser agents.

BrowserProof is an evidence-first TypeScript runner for AI-agent browser automation.
It checks explicit success conditions, captures final screenshots, hashes evidence,
and emits JSON plus HTML proof reports.

Repository: https://github.com/yashkhou/browserproof
Docs: https://yashkhou.github.io/browserproof/
License: MIT
Canonical technical source: the GitHub README and source code.
